# TraceNotice

TraceNotice provides technical implementation support for public AI transparency surfaces under EU AI Act Article 50. It reviews observable AI chat, voice and generative-AI experiences and turns findings into implementation actions, acceptance criteria and release-evidence checklists. TraceNotice is not a law firm and does not certify legal compliance.

## Key resources
- https://tracenotice.com/article-50-ai-act/ — EU AI Act Article 50 transparency obligations
- https://tracenotice.com/article-50-checklist/ — practical Article 50 implementation checklist
- https://tracenotice.com/ai-chatbot-disclosure/ — AI chatbot disclosure guidance
- https://tracenotice.com/voice-ai-disclosure/ — voice AI / AI phone-agent disclosure guidance
- https://tracenotice.com/ai-generated-content-labeling/ — AI-generated content labelling and marking
- https://tracenotice.com/sample/ — illustrative implementation output
- https://tracenotice.com/agency/ — agency release workflow

## Primary official references
- European Commission Article 50 guidelines: https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/library/guidelines-transparency-obligations-providers-and-deployers-ai-systems
- European Commission Article 50 Q&A: https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/faqs/transparency-obligations-under-article-50-ai-act
